root_cause_analyses.recommended_action: Re-torque fixture clamps to spec. Run test cut on scrap material before resuming production.

root_cause_analyses.root_cause: Thermal gradient during quench-hardening exceeded 180°C/min — residual tensile stress nucleated micro-crack.
root_cause_analyses.recommended_action: HALT production. 100% ultrasonic inspection of current batch. Adjust quench rate to ≤120°C/min.

root_cause_analyses.root_cause: Thermal soak non-uniformity in furnace zone 3 — thermocouple TC-07 calibration drift of +12°C.
root_cause_analyses.recommended_action: Recalibrate TC-07. Ramp furnace gradually. Measure warpage with CMM; re-straighten affected parts.
